description: An answer to a short transmission at the LOW-SPEED rung does not lower the answered rung: the next bulk transmission goes straight back to the MAX-SPEED rung already answered.
note: Link setup as dts-arq/ack-wait-expiry-retransmit: conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ, its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST 'ping' to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 at 0 makes the CAS call (request at 75000 at drc.default_speed, WN 2 Long, EOW EMPTY to a peer of unknown edition), and at 91000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED makes the link (16-bit family) and records the peer Ed4 (B-0408). That D_PDU's EOW is MAX-SPEED WN 4 Short (0x864: interleaver 011, speed 4), recorded (interp C-1262). On D_CONNECTION_MADE the rung the link was made at, drc.default_speed, position 0, counts as the last answered (interp C-1281). A transmission's rung is at most one above the last answered rung, a transmission of ARQ data above it is a trial, and a dts.ack_wait expiry with nothing heard from the peer since is a silent wait (open question 16); a silent wait after a trial is a failed trial, which caps the peer one rung below it for tx_ceiling_initial of its transmissions to the peer, doubling on each repeat failure up to tx_ceiling_cap (design shape item 7, interp C-1281); tx_step_down_waits silent waits in a row step down one rung (plan 6.2, interp C-1282); an answer (C-1250) ends the silence count and the step down and makes the last rung sent the answered one. Every data D_PDU to the peer is the first header to it in its transmission and carries SENDER-APPROACH, 0xB04 (interp C-1286); PADDING carries MAX-SEGMENT 255 (interp C-1271, C-1272). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150; WN 2 Long 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, WN 4 Long 50 bytes and 2400 ms (test data). The 29-byte DATA-ONLY needs two blocks at WN 2 Long (EOT 20, its PADDING in block 1 EOT 10, 10350 ms) and one at WN 4 Long (EOT and the PADDING's EOT ceil(2550 / 500) = 6, 3150 ms; one PADDING, 11 bytes). dts.ack_wait_ms 60000; after our own transmission, a queue that refills with nothing heard goes through LBT rule 3, 3000 ms (K-0071, K-0074); after a burst addressed only to us, rule 1 (K-0067). Contention waits are seed 0's draws, uniform(16) x 3000 ms (K-0080). drc.table (corpus-format.md 6.1): ladder WN 2 Long, WN 4 Long, WN 4 Short, WN 6 Long (positions 0 to 3); no thresholds, so this node's own MAX-SPEED and LOW-SPEED never get a value (corpus-format.md 6.2 step 6) and the mixed rotation it sends each Ed4 peer it has heard is MAX-SEGMENT 255 alone (0xAFF; no SENDER-APPROACH has come, C-0956; interp C-1271, C-1272), with no top priority; sender constants tx_step_down_waits 2, tx_ceiling_initial 2, tx_ceiling_cap 4. Fixture WN 4 Short: 50 bytes and 1200 ms a block (test data). The U_PDUs 'big1', 'big2' and 'big3' are 39 bytes (the text then 0x00 fill), so each DATA-ONLY is 64 bytes, more than one block of the MAX-SPEED rung WN 4 Short: a bulk transmission, at the MAX-SPEED rung (open question 7, interp C-1285). 'ping' is a 29-byte DATA-ONLY, one block: a latency transmission, at the LOW-SPEED rung once one has come (interp C-1284). At 108000 'big1' (FSN 0) would go at WN 4 Short, position 2, but the answered rung is drc.default_speed, position 0, so it goes at WN 4 Long, one above it: a trial (interp C-1281). The ACK-ONLY at 116000 (RX LWE 1) answers it and carries LOW-SPEED WN 2 Long (0x9A2), recorded (interp C-1262): the answered rung is WN 4 Long. 'big2' (FSN 1, requested at 120000) goes at WN 4 Short, one above, a trial, answered by an ACK-ONLY (RX LWE 2) with LOW-SPEED WN 2 Long again: the answered rung is WN 4 Short. 'ping' (FSN 2) is for latency and goes at the LOW-SPEED rung WN 2 Long (two blocks there, as in the P7-7 scenarios), below the answered rung, so not a trial; its answer (RX LWE 3) leaves the answered rung at WN 4 Short, the highest answered (interp C-1281 as revised in corpus 0.35.0; before, the answer made WN 2 Long the answered rung and 'big3' could go no higher than WN 4 Long). 'big3' (FSN 3) goes at WN 4 Short, the MAX-SPEED rung. Each request after an answer cancels sis.soft_link_idle (A-0320) and restarts dts.ttd; the answer that confirms the queue's last C_PDU cancels dts.ttd and starts the idle wait (A-0321: three answer waits, 180000).
